items.myth: Taking an education loan is wrong
items.fact: With the right plan, a loan is a tool
items.detail: Understand the repayment plan first, then decide.

items.myth: You should go only on a scholarship
items.detail: Savings, scholarship and loan. All three together make a more practical plan.

items.myth: The lowest-rate loan is always best
items.detail: Also compare processing fees, when repayment starts, and the conditions.

youtube.title: Is taking an education loan wrong? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
3 big money myths. With the right plan, a loan is a tool. Mix your funding (savings, scholarship, loan). And compare the total cost and terms, not just the interest rate.
